supporting_reports.evidence: Braking action was poor and the aircraft overran the runway end by 60 metres into the runway end safety area.
With one thrust reverser unavailable, a long landing on a contaminated runway ended in a low-speed overrun past the runway end.
After an unstabilized, fast approach the aircraft touched down 2,500 feet beyond the threshold on a runway reported with standing water and came to a stop in the overrun area.

concerns: SAMPLE-012 overran on a contaminated runway, but the report does not say the landing was long or fast. SME to decide whether the category should cover all contaminated-runway overruns.
